edits: your edit changes step 1's request, and scripted holds only the recorded answer to the original — run on live, or drop the edit
model: scripted cannot try another model: it replays the answers the source's own model recorded — run on live, or drop the model override
no source: scripted replays a recorded run's answers: pick a source run, or run on live
past end: scripted has no recorded answer for step 2: the source never answered it — run on live, or replay from an earlier step
prompt: scripted cannot try a changed system prompt: the recorded answers ignore the prompt, so it would replay the old answer — run on live, or drop the prompt change
